purpose: Catch recommendation failures where a plausible taste hypothesis is not carried into real product candidates, page-level teaser prices are mistaken for the selected option price, or later user corrections fail to update ranking.

scenario.initial_request: 온라인에서 살 수 있는 삼겹살이나 오겹살을 추천해 줘. 지방의 고소함이 중심이고 육향은 약간 있으면 좋다.

objective_slots: very cheap but not notably bad

scenario.assistant_hypothesis_example: A Berkshire-type pork product may fit the stated taste preference.
scenario.later_user_correction: 2500원대도 쓸데없이 비싸다고 생각해서 보통 2000원대 또는 그 이하를 먹는다.

normalized_constraint_after_correction.over_cap_policy: Only keep above-cap candidates as explicit exceptions with strong evidence and user-visible justification.

fixed_product_fixtures.page_title: 삼겹살 / 오겹살 / 듀록 삼겹살 / 듀록 오겹살 2kg
fixed_product_fixtures.regression_trap: Do not report 1345 KRW/100g for the selected Duroc option.
Do not omit ordinary low-price candidates merely because a breed hypothesis sounds more premium.

required_behavior: If a breed, brand, product class, or method is presented as a taste-fit hypothesis, inspect at least one concrete candidate from that hypothesis or explicitly state that no candidate survived the constraints.
Collect a reasonably broad candidate pool before narrowing on the taste hypothesis.
For each recommended purchasable product, bind price claims to the exact selected option or SKU rather than the page-level base price.
Include option surcharge, selected weight or quantity, and current availability in the verification chain before presenting normalized unit price as verified.
Preserve the two objective slots instead of collapsing cheap-value and taste-value into one score.
After the user lowers the practical price ceiling, rerank or remove earlier candidates that conflict with the new ceiling.
Use a direct product detail page when a link is presented as the purchase link.
fail_conditions: States that Berkshire is the best taste fit but never inspects a Berkshire candidate and never explains why it was excluded.
Uses the page base price for a selected option with a surcharge.
Recommends before exact option price or availability is verified.
Keeps 2400-2500 KRW/100g products as ordinary top picks after the user makes 2000 KRW/100g the practical ceiling.
Searches only the inferred premium breed or brand class and misses materially cheaper ordinary candidates.
Provides only a search-results or category link while presenting it as the exact product link.
